authority: owner delegated the decisions to the agent ('nach wissenschaftlicher Praxis selbst entscheiden'); committed before any test episode, together with the frozen analysis code
trigger: independent review of the analysis code (tools/analyze_x1x2.py, src/argus/evaluation/statistics.py) before its freeze

decisions.A1_replacement_slot: a replacement building takes the slot (list position) of the building it replaced, as logged in run_plan.json; prefix and truncation rules count slots, not manifest positions
decisions.A2_failed_episode_coverage: an episode that failed keeps the coverage reached before its failure tick (traced), held to the horizon; an episode killed by the hard timeout has no trace and gets coverage 0 for every target set; it contributes no repair-lag events and no runtime sample (counted separately)
decisions.A3_terminal_batch: the analysis runs only on a finished batch: complete to the planned B, or stopped by its budget (sessions.jsonl); paused, breaker- or infrastructure-stopped batches are resumed first; no LOCK or PAUSE; the source tree must equal the one in run_plan.json; every analysis run is logged in analysis_log.jsonl
decisions.A4_holm_family: the secondary inferential family is the 8 per-cell gains of the candidate against the H2 control plus the 3 H1 interaction contrasts of the candidate on id_test (11 tests, two-sided bootstrap p with +1 correction, Holm); if a per-cell gain is undefined (A5), that member is the p of the absolute difference in that cell; all other secondary quantities and all OOD results are estimates with percentile intervals and no p-value
decisions.A5_zero_control: the absolute difference M(candidate) - M(control) is always reported with its interval; if the control mean is zero in the data or in any bootstrap draw, the ratio gain is undefined and only the difference is reported; an undefined primary gain or coverage loss means H2 is not supported
decisions.A6_lags_scope: repair lags are computed per list (id_test primary, ood_test per family), reported as Kaplan-Meier curve up to tau, restricted mean, censoring rate and the number at risk at tau
decisions.A7_pairs_without_failure: pairs (building, cell, replicate) with a failure of either method are left out, cells average their remaining pairs, buildings without any pair drop out of this sensitivity bootstrap; n per family is reported, and a result left with a single family or no building is flagged, not family-weighted
decisions.A8_calibration: Brier and NLL per building pooled over all answered probes of the method in that building (equal weight per probe), then the family-weighted mean over buildings; episodes without answered probes are counted; the NLL clipping rate is reported
decisions.A9_ood: ood_test is analysed per family with the same estimand set as id_test, descriptively, without p-values and without a claim
decisions.A10_js: JS between candidate and H2 control on identical answered probes: mean per pair (building, cell, replicate), then over replicates and cells (equal weights) per building; buildings without common probes are excluded and counted
decisions.A11_even_b: the planned B rounds the preregistered formula up to an even number (78.15 -> 79 -> 80) so that every prefix is family-balanced; this is a conservative deviation from the formula text
decisions.A12_resource_limits: 'under equal resource limits' is satisfied by design (same byte budget, horizon and robots for every method); sent bytes per method are reported, not tested
